hero.tagline: Open your store in 10 minutes. Your data, your control.
hero.description: DingPOS is a server-less point of sale for iPad. No account, no cloud lock-in, and it keeps working with no internet. Your products, orders, and customers all stay on your own device.
hero.note: 30-day full-feature free trial. No credit card required.

features.title: Everything you need to open a store
features.subtitle: From checkout to inventory, promotions to backup — all on a single iPad

offline.title: No network, no account
offline.desc: Checkout works even without WiFi. No sign-up, no cloud service to bind — just open the app and start selling.

setup.title: Open in 10 minutes
setup.desc: A guided setup wizard fills in your currency and tax rate from your country, adds your store name and a few products, and you're ready to take your first payment.

cashier.title: Multi-cart checkout & discounts
cashier.desc: Run up to 10 carts at once, with product search, variant picking, item and cart discounts, and cash change. Every sale ends with a satisfying "Ding!"

inventory.title: Products, variants & stock
inventory.desc: Multi-axis variants (size / color), barcode scanning, product photos, plus per-product stock tracking with a full movement ledger.

promotion.title: Promotion engine & loyalty
promotion.desc: Set up threshold discounts, buy-one-get-one, happy hours, member tiers, and points rewards. They apply automatically at checkout — no coupon codes to type.

sync.title: Cloud backup, your provider
sync.desc: Choose iCloud, Google Drive, or Dropbox. Backups go into your own cloud account. Switch devices, reconnect, and everything restores.

pricing.title: Simple, transparent pricing
pricing.price: 30-day full-feature free trial, then NT$299 per month.
pricing.sub: No transaction fees, no hidden charges. Your data is always kept after the trial — resubscribe anytime.

footer.tagline: Open your store in 10 minutes. Your data, your control.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: ALU Studio ("we") developed DingPOS ("the app"). DingPOS is a point of sale built with privacy at its core — your business data belongs to you. This Privacy Policy explains how we handle your information when you use the app.

local_storage.title: How your data is stored
local_storage.desc: DingPOS stores all of your business data locally on your device. Unless you actively enable cloud backup, this data never leaves your device. The data you create in the app includes:
items: Store settings (store name, currency, tax rate, logo)
Product data (name, price, cost, barcode, photo, category, variants, stock)
Order and transaction records (including discounts, tax, payment method)
Customer and membership data (name, optional phone and email, points)

cloud_backup.title: Cloud backup (optional)
cloud_backup.desc: You can optionally enable cloud backup and choose one of iCloud, Google Drive, or Dropbox as the storage location. Backups are written to your own cloud account and remain fully under your control. We never handle, store, or access the contents of these backups. Whether to enable backup, and which provider to use, is entirely your choice and can be turned off at any time.

no_collection.title: What we do not collect
no_collection.desc: DingPOS does not collect, transmit, or share any of your business content. Specifically, we do not:
items: Collect your product, order, customer, or membership data
Touch any payment flow or credit card information (the app does not process actual card payments)
Share your business data with any third party

camera.title: Camera & photos
camera.desc: DingPOS requests camera access only when you actively use "scan barcode" or "take a product photo". Barcode recognition and photos are processed locally on your device and are never uploaded to our servers. Product photos are only written to your own cloud account as part of a backup, if you enable cloud backup.

subscription.title: Subscription & purchases
subscription.desc: DingPOS offers a subscription through Apple App Store In-App Purchase (IAP), using RevenueCat to manage subscription status. Payment is handled by Apple; we never receive your credit card or payment details. RevenueCat receives only an anonymous identifier tied to subscription status, used to verify whether your subscription is active.

analytics.title: Analytics & crash reporting
analytics.desc: DingPOS uses Firebase Analytics and Firebase Crashlytics, provided by Google, to help us understand how the app is used and to identify and fix crashes. These services collect:
items: Anonymous usage data (e.g. which features are used, session length)
Crash reports (e.g. stack traces, device model, OS version)
Device information (e.g. device type, OS, app version)
A randomly generated instance identifier (not linked to your identity)
analytics.note: This data is anonymous and does not include any of your business content (such as products, orders, customers, or members). To learn more about how Google handles this data, see Google's Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy.

children.title: Children's privacy
children.desc: DingPOS is a commercial point-of-sale tool. It is not designed for children and does not collect children's personal information.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.desc: If we make material changes to this Privacy Policy, we will notify you through an app update. We recommend reviewing this policy periodically.

terms.intro: Welcome to DingPOS. Please read the following Terms of Use carefully before using the app. By downloading, installing, or using DingPOS, you agree to be bound by these terms.

license.title: License
license.desc: ALU Studio grants you a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable license to use DingPOS on your devices to run your business. This license is for your retail operations.

subscription.title: Subscription & payment
subscription.desc: DingPOS offers a 30-day full-feature free trial from first install. After the trial, a subscription of NT$299 per month (via App Store In-App Purchase) is required to continue using checkout; browsing and product management remain available and your data is never deleted. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time in your device's App Store account settings. Purchased subscriptions support restore.

restrictions.title: Restrictions
restrictions.desc: When using the app, you agree not to:
items: Reverse engineer, disassemble, or decompile the app
Modify, translate, or create derivative works
Remove any copyright notices or labels within the app
Use the app for any unlawful purpose

user_data.title: Your data & backups
user_data.desc: All business content you create in DingPOS (products, orders, customers, members, and settings) is stored on your device and is your sole responsibility. If you delete the app or clear its data, all stored information is permanently lost unless you have enabled cloud backup. Cloud backups reside in the cloud account you choose (iCloud / Google Drive / Dropbox) and their availability and retention are governed by that provider's terms of service. We cannot recover any data for you. You are also responsible for complying with the tax, invoicing, and consumer-protection laws applicable to where you operate.

updates.title: App updates
updates.desc: We may release app updates from time to time to improve features, fix issues, or enhance security. We recommend keeping the app up to date for the best experience.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.desc: DingPOS is provided "as is", without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee that the app will operate uninterrupted or be entirely error-free. DingPOS is a tool to assist your operations; the ultimate accuracy of tax calculations, stock quantities, and all amounts, as well as compliance with local regulations, remain your responsibility to verify. To the maximum extent permitted by law, we are not liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the app.

liability.title: Limitation of liability

This includes, but is not limited to, data loss, lost revenue, device damage, or any other loss.
